title: Microsoft's AI Spending Sparks Stock Drop — 2026-01-29
description: Microsoft's stock took a hit, falling 6% as investors react to its record AI spending overshadowing an earnings beat. Meanwhile, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Amazon are in talks to invest up to $60 billion in OpenAI, signaling a massive push in AI innovation. What does this mean for the tech industry and investors? Also, Tesla invests $2 billion in xAI, and Meta forecasts spending of at least $115 billion this year.
